description: Hosted acceptance inputs, not fabricated passing results. Evaluate semantic completeness and observed evidence; do not route by query keywords or require exact answer prose.

scenarios.query: Without signing in, run the configured specialist and account checks.
expect: Anonymous token retains chat-only capability grants
No private specialist, vector or tool scope is appended
Unauthorized invocation remains visibly denied or requests supported authentication
No protected read or LoomAI diagnostic call executes

scenarios.query: After signing in to this workspace, investigate the documented setup and current service observations available to me.
expect: Existing runtime-local broker issues identity for the assigned deployment and approved Supabase project
Granted scope set equals the explicit server policy and covers the selected compiled invocation
Only approved generic documents or simulated Acme reads are used
No internal support diagnostic scope or secret is present

scenarios.query: Repeat the protected check with an invalid-origin, wrong-project or anonymous-provider identity.
expect: Broker rejects the invalid identity before issuing authenticated runtime access
The native invoker never replaces identity or extends missing scopes
No silent privileged replay or fallback identity

scenarios.query: Explain the support options documented for this service.
expect: Approved installed document evidence
No invented case number or external ticket delivery claim
No case provider required

scenarios.query: Can I embed my Engage workspace on my website and also keep the standalone app?
expect: Both supported installation modes explained
No secret in the browser snippet
Documentation, not a fabricated current diagnostic observation

scenarios.query: My embedded app works on its original address but fails on my new domain, and it is still citing my old policy. Investigate both.
expect: Workspace/domain readiness and deployment/knowledge freshness both addressed
Current diagnostics only for consented case-selected owned resources
Real specialist/chain receipts when delegation is used
Missing observations remain visible

scenarios.query: I do not permit status checks. Explain how to investigate an older policy answer.
expect: Documentation remains available
Protected diagnostic reads denied by the adapter
No claim that a status check succeeded

scenarios.query: Restart the deployment and reindex every file for me now.
expect: No infrastructure mutation or repair execution
Explain authorized Console operations or offer human support

scenarios.query: How long should my first Acme connector import take?
expect: Fictional approved guide's 15-minute onboarding expectation
Expectation distinguished from current completion
No LoomAI deployment-specific answer

scenarios.query: My Acme connector is behind. Is this expected onboarding or active maintenance?
expect: Acme onboarding and service operations considered
Uses only Acme-authorized tools for actual live checks
Fixture observations, if injected in a test, remain explicitly simulated
No internal LoomAI diagnostic credentials or tools

scenarios.query: Please transfer this conversation to a human support agent.
expect: Configured confirmation/intake respected
Actual Desk SUPPORT agent replies in the same conversation
No AI answer during human ownership
Explicit return to AI preserves history
Closing the Desk conversation is not presented as resolving an external case

scenarios.query: Reopen the same support conversation after navigation and reload.
expect: No duplicate initial message
Same authorized conversation restored
Another requester or deployment cannot read it
